notes.title: Epicenter VR 1.2 Release!
notes.content:
Update 1.2 is finally ready and available now! This update is probably the biggest yet, and I look forward to hearing any feedback here or on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/CWN2tyZmCY]Discord[/url]!

Here's the patch notes!

[h1]New stuff![/h1]

[b]HTC Vive is now officially supported[/b]
New tutorial text for Vive specific controls
Added Steamworks integration
Added [b]achievements[/b] and some stats
Added the PEQ-15 laser/light combo for the M4
Added grenades to soldier zombies
Added in-game radio
Added ambient sounds
Added vibration when shooting all guns
Added [spoiler]alarm sounds to the helicopter crash[/spoiler]
Added highlight to grenade pins

[h1]Changes and fixes![/h1]

Fixed physics on some items missed in previous item throwing changes
Fixed issue where zombies would spawn inside buildings
Fixed turn speed to no longer be tied to frame rate
Fixed M2 Browning machine gun's shell ejection
Fixed M2 Browning fire rate to be slower
Increased zombie count in all missions
Decreased size of collectable mission items in missions 2 and 3
Fixed Benelli M4 shotgun to not have a shell loaded by default
Removed invisible walls around the motel
Lowered secondary grip offset for long guns (M4 rifle, shotgun, AK) to be more in line with the player's hand
Fixed issue where NPCs would sometimes move without an animation, causing them to glide
Cleaned up some code adjacent to new achievement triggers to improve performance

That should be everything! If you have questions or any issues while trying out the new stuff, drop by the Discord and let me know! 

-Circuit

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.1
notes.content:
Got a really short and sweet patch for you all. Turns out I managed to miss a checkbox allowing the new shotgun, flare gun, and their ammo types to be held with a toggled grip. This bug only affected those who had the toggle grip option enabled in the first place, so if you hadn't noticed or thought it was fine already, that's probably why.

So here's the patch note:

Fixed not being able to toggle grip on:
[list]
[*] Benelli M4
[*] Flare Gun
[*] Buckshot
[*] Slugs
[*] Flares
[/list]

Thanks to the user who commented on the Version 1.1 announcement with the bug. If you'd like a centralized place to post about the game and report future issues and ideas, join the [url=https://discord.gg/CWN2tyZmCY]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Epicenter VR version 1.1 is now available!
notes.content:
Update 1.1 has finally arrived! This update brings two new guns, vastly improved throwing, and more!

Added Flare Gun
Added Flare
Added Benelli M4 Shotgun
Added Buckshot
Added Slug

Added ability to stack shotgun shells/flares in hand and inventory
Added ability to store shotgun shells in shell holder on the Benelli M4
Added tactical AK reload
Added ability to shoot grenades and flashbangs to detonate them

Updated all item offsets in player inventory
Updated some item offsets in hand (namely the AK Mag)
Updated throwing distance for all items (grenades are now viable)
Updated ejection direction and force for all spent shells
Updated chamber location on some guns
Updated fire rates on M4 and AK to be slower

Fixed issue where sometimes shots would not make noise for the zombies
Fixed issue where dead, ragdolled, or dismembered zombies would flee from flashbang explosions
Fixed null reference issue with exploding barrels in the dev/test scene

Known issue: The player has to use the A button to release the shotgun slide if the mag tube is empty
Workaround: None, press A to drop the slide or put a shell into the mag tube. Then the slide will unlock if you grab it.


If you have any issues or just want to come by and hangout, join the official [url=https://discord.gg/CWN2tyZmCY]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
This patch addresses quite a few bugs and issues brought to my attention since last month, as well as news related to [b]modding[/b]! Thanks to those on my Discord for helping me identify and patch them!

Here's a breakdown of the patch:

[list]
[*] Fixed NPCs walking though machine gun defenses
[*] Changed NPC behavior in mission 5, they now run to the police station and despawn at its door
[*] Converted most building's and object's colliders to concave mesh colliders. This should eliminate issues with shooting and moving around affected props
[*] Every ladder in the world has been updated to be climbable
[*] Updated colliders on broken fences to allow the player to walk through them
[*] Fixed misplaced flare VFX in mission 3
[*] Shortened mission 4 text
[*] Added a light next to the machine gun in mission 5 to guide the player's eye toward it better
[*] Extended playable area in the truck-bed during the end sequence
[*] Scaled down objects and props in the environment (If I missed any, send a screenshot/bug report)
[*] Added a toggle for the virtual stock
[/list]

[h2]Modding related update![/h2]
Also with this update comes a Mono build of the game on a secondary branch! This should help with modding and give anyone interested in doing so easy access to the code.

That's all for now! Join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/CWN2tyZmCY]Discord[/url] for insight into future updates, and a place to post bug reports or suggestions! 

-Circuit

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.content:
Got another patch for everyone today! This one focuses on two issues regarding the mounted flashlight for the M4 rifle. Here are the patch notes:

- Changed input for removing the weapon mounted flashlight to the trigger. 
- While holding the M4 rifle with both hands, the player can now use the trigger on the forward hand to toggle any mounted flashlight.

I may update all attachments to be removed using the trigger in the future, but for now I wanted to address the specific case where trying to grab the M4's foregrip while a flashlight was attached would often cause the player to remove the flashlight from the rifle instead.

To discuss these changes and submit bug reports, check out my official [url=https://discord.com/invite/CWN2tyZmCY]Discord[/url]! 

-Circuit

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1 Live!
notes.content:
Turns out that when you heal using a medkit, only the UI on the tablet would update, and not the player's actual health value! This has been fixed! 

This bug was reported on my [url=https://discord.com/invite/CWN2tyZmCY]Discord[/url]. Feel free to join and share your experience with the game or any issues you encounter!

-Circuit

notes.title: Epicenter VR is now available!
notes.content:
Epicenter VR is now available for download on Steam! 

Join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/CWN2tyZmCY]Discord[/url] for news on updates, as well as a place to submit bug reports. I'm looking forward to hearing any feedback I can get!

notes.title: Day 1 Patch
notes.content:
Epicenter VR's first patch is [b]now complete[/b]! These updates are based on feedback I received during an early access live stream hosted by [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fiEhWUdeW6Q]IndieVR[/url] on YouTube! 

Here is a break down of the patch:

Added glowing outline to objective items (Appears when close by, you'll still need to follow the compass)
Added damage indication on screen
Added suppressor spawner to ammo box
Added player footsteps sounds
Updated tutorial text
Resized tutorial area's props/text
Moved options panel down in main menu scene
Increased player step height
Updated mission compass headings to more closely align with objective locations
Info tablet now gives an audible chime when it updates the active objective
Zombies can now hear the player moving around (the faster you move, the further they hear you)
Increased zombie FOV from 75 to 150
Fixed police station gate not closing when the mission giver is talking to the player
Removed excess colliders on grass near trees (should prevent getting stuck as often)

That's all for now!
-Circuit

notes.title: Epicenter VR is releasing Friday!
notes.content: It's been 3 long years since I started working on Epicenter VR. It started as a flat-screen game for a school project a year before that, and between my last few semesters and work, I took that project and ported it to VR in the hopes of publishing my first game on Steam. Today I'm excited to make the announcement that Epicenter VR will be releasing [b]this Friday[/b] (July 21st) and will be [b]free-to-play[/b].
